description: Fetch the FULL text of one indexed Canton-ecosystem documentation page (Canton/Daml/Splice and integrated partner docs) by its numeric id. Canton-specific. Use this AFTER search or semantic_search returns a doc id, to read complete commands, flags, and full sections a search snippet truncates. Requires an id. Not a discovery tool; use search/semantic_search first.

id.description: Doc page ID from a search/semantic_search result, e.g. 3242 or "doc:3242". Not a forum topic id: those go to get_discussion.

name: get_doc
